The '''TIE Defender combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. It had an engraving of a TIE/D Defender.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the Defender's dogfighting capabilities as well as using its [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor-beam]] projector offensively. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of an operation dealing with inspecting cargo and detaining any [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-aligned smugglers. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as a reenactment of a disable-and-capture mission against a fleet of Rebel escort carriers.

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the TIE Defender shortly after the TIE/D Defender [[T/D Technology|entered mass production]] during the [[Zaarin insurrection]].
